# nemau storage object

Manage the objects in a container.

## Usage

```
nemau storage object [command]
```

Aliases: `objects`, `obj`

## Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [copy](nemau_storage_object_copy.md) | Copy an object, server-side |
| [delete](nemau_storage_object_delete.md) | Delete an object |
| [get](nemau_storage_object_get.md) | Download an object |
| [list](nemau_storage_object_list.md) | List the objects in a container |
| [presign](nemau_storage_object_presign.md) | Get a direct URL to an object, bypassing the API |
| [put](nemau_storage_object_put.md) | Upload an object |

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
